stories.story_fr: Les états financiers trimestriels n'ont subi aucune modification depuis les annonces précédentes.
stories.story_en: The quarterly financial statements remained unchanged from the prior announcements.
stories.quote: There have been no changes to the Japanese GAAP quarterly consolidated financial statements for the same period originally announced on February 4 and February 5, 2026.

stories.story_fr: Le résultat d'exploitation a augmenté de 275 milliards ¥, atteignant 1 905,9 milliards ¥.
stories.story_en: Net Operating Profit rose by ¥275 bn to ¥1,905.9 bn.
stories.quote: Net Operating Profits: ¥1,905.9bn, up by ¥275.0bn YoY

stories.story_fr: Le résultat net a progressé de 87,8 milliards ¥, atteignant 1 813,5 milliards ¥.
stories.story_en: Net Income increased by ¥87.8 bn to ¥1,813.5 bn.

stories.story_fr: Le taux de change USD/JPY a légèrement baissé, passant de 158,18 à 156,56.
stories.story_en: The USD/JPY exchange rate slipped from 158.18 to 156.56.
stories.quote: FX rate End Dec 2024 158.18  End Dec 2025 156.56

stories.story_fr: Les revenus d'intérêt ont augmenté de 5 % grâce au rééquilibrage du portefeuille obligataire.
stories.story_en: Interest income rose 5 % driven by bond‑portfolio rebalancing.
stories.quote: Interest income increase from last year’s bond portfolio rebalancing +87.8 +5%
